query:
SELECT DISTINCT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.value, '$.ser_nome')) AS ser_nome,
       SUM(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.value, '$.sum')) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS total
FROM faturamento_colaboradores fc
JOIN JSON_TABLE(fc.detalhes_servicos, '$[*]' COLUMNS (value JSON PATH '$')) AS j
WHERE fc.mes = 5 AND fc.ano = 2026
  AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.value, '$.ser_nome')) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ser_nome
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 50;
